extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo_total is null and recurring capex is not applicable (null). The reconciliation starts from net income available to common stockholders. Amounts are in thousands; the share count 67,621,842 was converted to 67,621.842 thousands. Subtotals check: 73,254 + adjustments = 227,112; 227,112 + adjustments = 228,162. FFO per share 227,112/67,621.842 = 3.36 and Core 228,162/67,621.842 = 3.37, both matching. Zero-valued lines ('Gains not included in FFO', 'Loss on early retirement of debt, net', 'Insurance reimbursements...') are printed as '-' for Q1 2022 and are recorded as 0. The same figures appear on page seq 17 (S-3). Page printed numbers are blank in the markers provided.
